payload.body: At af5bb999, three surfaces outside architect-sees-the-design still describe the architect's old position. packages/canon/src/skills/deliver/skill.ts:132 says self reads the plan view, the assay and the integrator's gate result; deliver is now the integrator's skill and deliver-loop is the unit that realizes it, so this is probably that unit's to correct. packages/canon/src/roles/hold.ts:25 still says an architect hands a cut piece to a planner, where the design now says shard. docs/role.md:24 quotes the old arrow reads⟨intent · C · plan-view · note · assay · gate-result⟩ → writes⟨C · note · verdict⟩; it is a disposition record of earlier work, so it may be meant to stay as history.
